arxiv-2108-13951.title: Collective modes in imbalanced nodal line semimetal
arxiv-2108-13951.creator: SK Firoz Islam, Alexander A. Zyuzin
arxiv-2108-13951.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate collective modes in a nodal line semimetal with two nodal-lines that have opposite spin polarization in the presence of spin population imbalance. We find the components of polarization operator taking into account the electron-electron exchange interaction and obtain the dispersion relations of collective modes for the bulk and surface states.

arxiv-2203-01295.title: Dynamic Coupling Strategy for Interdependent Network Systems Against Cascading Failures
arxiv-2203-01295.creator: I-Cheng Lin, Osman Yağan, Carlee Joe-Wong
arxiv-2203-01295.description: Abstract Cascading failures are a common phenomenon in complex networked systems where failures at only a few nodes may trigger a process of sequential failure. We applied a flow redistribution model to investigate the robustness against cascading failures in modern systems carrying flows/loads (i.e. power grid, transportation system, etc.) that contain multiple interdependent networks.

arxiv-2411-02864.title: Graph-DPEP: Decomposed Plug and Ensemble Play for Few-Shot Document Relation Extraction with Graph-of-Thoughts Reasoning
arxiv-2411-02864.creator: Tao Zhang, Ning Yan, Masood Mortazavi, Hoang H. Nguyen, Zhongfen Deng, Philip S. Yu
arxiv-2411-02864.description: Abstract . Large language models (LLMs) pre-trained on massive corpora have demonstrated impressive few-shot learning capability on many NLP tasks. Recasting an NLP task into a text-to-text generation task is a common practice so that generative LLMs can be prompted to resolve it.

arxiv-2504-04722.title: TactileNet: Bridging the Accessibility Gap with AI-Generated Tactile Graphics for Individuals with Vision Impairment
arxiv-2504-04722.creator: Adnan Khan, Alireza Choubineh, Mai A. Shaaban, Abbas Akkasi, Majid Komeili
arxiv-2504-04722.description: Abstract Tactile graphics are essential for providing access to visual information for the 43 million people globally living with vision loss. Traditional methods for creating these graphics are labor-intensive and cannot meet growing demand. We introduce TactileNet , the first comprehensive dataset and AI-driven framework for generating embossing-ready 2D tactile templates using text-to-image Stable Diffusion (SD) models.

arxiv-2507-20473.title: Nonlinear transmission line: shock waves and the simple wave approximation
arxiv-2507-20473.creator: Eugene Kogan
arxiv-2507-20473.description: Abstract In the first part of the paper we obtain the analytic solution for the profile of a shock wave in a nonlinear lossy transmission line, constructed from the inductors, the capacitors and the resistors. both the charge of a capacitor and a current through the inductor are obtained as the functions of the time and space coordinate.

arxiv-2510-27692.title: LifWavNet: Lifting Wavelet-based Network for Non-contact ECG Reconstruction from Radar
arxiv-2510-27692.creator: Soumitra Kundu, Gargi Panda, Saumik Bhattacharya, Aurobinda Routray, Rajlakshmi Guha
arxiv-2510-27692.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Soumitra Kundu, Gargi Panda, Saumik Bhattacharya, Aurobinda Routray, Rajlakshmi Guha. Non-contact electrocardiogram (ECG) reconstruction from radar signals offers a promising approach for unobtrusive cardiac monitoring. We present LifWavNet, a lifting wavelet network based on a multi-resolution analysis and synthesis (MRAS) model for radar-to-ECG reconstruction. Unlike prior models that use fixed wavelet approaches, LifWavNet employs learnable lifting wavelets with lifting and inverse lifting units to adaptively capture radar signal features and synthesize physiologically meaningful ECG waveforms.

arxiv-2511-06959.title: Reduced kinetic model for ion temperature gradient instability in tokamaks with reversed magnetic shear
arxiv-2511-06959.creator: B. Jia, Q. Zhong, Y. Li, Y. Xiao
arxiv-2511-06959.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by B. Jia, Q. Zhong, Y. Li, Y. Xiao. Using the averaged magnetic drift model and a first-order finite Larmor radius (FLR) expansion, the eigenvalue equation for the ion temperature gradient (ITG) mode in tokamak plasmas is reduced to a Schrödinger-type differential equation. By invoking generalized translational invariance, the model is extended to reversed magnetic shear (RMS) configurations and benchmarked against global gyrokinetic simulations from GTC, showing good quantitative agreement.

pmc-10571089.title: 31P Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy as a Probe of Thorium–Phosphorus Bond Covalency: Correlating Phosphorus Chemical Shift to Metal–Phosphorus Bond Order
pmc-10571089.creator: Jingzhen Du, Joseph Hurd, John A. Seed, Gábor Balázs, Manfred Scheer, Ralph W. Adams, Daniel Lee, Stephen T. Liddle
pmc-10571089.description: We report the use of solution and solid-state 31P Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy combined with Density Functional Theory calculations to benchmark the covalency of actinide-phosphorus bonds, thus introducing 31P NMR spectroscopy to the investigation of molecular f-element chemical bond covalency.

pmc-10627083.title: Professional Quality of Life Among Professionals Working with People with Eating Disorders: The Interplay Between Meaning in Work, Optimism, and Career Duration
pmc-10627083.creator: Yaira Hamama-Raz, Shachar Mazor
pmc-10627083.description: PurposeScientific literature findings reflect the challenges experienced by healthcare professionals (HCPs) whose work is dedicated to helping clients with eating disorders (EDs) in various treatment centers (wards). These challenges can affect the professional quality of life (comprised of compassion satisfaction, burnout, and secondary traumatic stress) of HCPs.

pmc-10641573.title: A review on linking stress, depression, and insulin resistance via low-grade chronic inflammation
pmc-10641573.creator: Seema Mehdi, Shahid Ud Din Wani, KL Krishna, Nabeel Kinattingal, Tamsheel Fatima Roohi
pmc-10641573.description: Stress is a disturbance in homeostasis caused by psychological, physiological, or environmental factors. Prolonged reactions to chronic stress can be detrimental, resulting in various metabolic abnormalities, referred to as metabolic syndrome (MS). There is a reciprocal increased risk between MS and major depressive disorder.

pmc-10706012.title: Manual Lymph Drainage for Post-COVID-19 Related Cough, Breathlessness, and Fatigue; Two Case Reports
pmc-10706012.creator: Bronwyn Overall, Kaori Langley, Janet Douglass
pmc-10706012.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background: Persistent symptoms after SARS CoV-2 infection such as fatigue, shortness of breath, and cognitive dysfunction that cannot be explained by an alternative diagnosis have been termed long COVID and present a significant emerging public health problem. Current approaches include rehabilitation and symptom management involving multiple health disciplines and as yet there are no pharmaceutical approaches other than routine symptom management.

pmc-11423549.title: The Role of the Cardiac Surgery Patient in Pain Management: The Patient Perspective
pmc-11423549.creator: Laura L Walton, Elsie Duff, Rakesh C Arora, Diana E McMillan
pmc-11423549.description: One and a half million cardiac surgeries are completed worldwide each year where undertreated postoperative pain increases the risk of patient morbidity and mortality. Patient-centered pain management is recommended to improve patient outcomes but there is insufficient information regarding how the patient views their role.

pmc-11561566.title: Should the current radiation protection paradigm and its recommendations be modified to make them more fit to protect the public in future nuclear emergencies?
pmc-11561566.creator: James Mc Laughlin
pmc-11561566.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The present radiation protection paradigm and its associated recommendations as developed by bodies such as the ICRP have performed very well over past decades both for those occupationally exposed to radiation and for the public in planned exposures. There is, however, growing evidence that the role played by this paradigm in the decision-making process to protect the public in nuclear emergencies in the past may have, unwittingly and unintentionally, caused more harm than good to some sections of the public.

pmc-12365138.title: Apelin as a CNS-specific pathway for fenestrated capillary formation in the choroid plexus
pmc-12365138.creator: Lukas Herdt, Stefan Baumeister, Jeshma Ravindra, Jean Eberlein, Christian S. M. Helker
pmc-12365138.description: The cerebral vasculature consists of a heterogenous network of blood vessels, including barrier-forming capillaries with blood-brain-barrier (BBB) properties and fenestrated capillaries specialized for molecular exchange. While key pathways regulating BBB vessel formation have been identified, the mechanisms driving fenestrated vessel development remain poorly understood.

pmc-12568276.title: In Vitro Effect of Elevated Ammonia and Urea Levels on Post-Thawed Bull Semen Sperm Characteristics
pmc-12568276.creator: Amine Abdelli, Mohamed Besbaci, Ziyad Al-Kass, Mokrane Iguer-Ouada, Jane M. Morrell
pmc-12568276.description: Simple SummaryThis study investigated the effects of ammonia and urea, at levels found in cattle fed high-nitrogen diets, on bull sperm quality. Thawed semen was incubated with low and high concentrations of each compound, and sperm motility, viability, DNA integrity, mitochondrial function, and oxidative stress were measured. High ammonia significantly reduced mitochondrial activity and sperm movement.

pmc-12696104.title: opynfield: An Open-Source Python Package for the Analysis of Open Field Exploration Data
pmc-12696104.creator: Ellen McMullen, Miguel de la Flor, Gemunu Gunaratne, Jason O’Connor, Gregg Roman
pmc-12696104.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The open field test is widely used in behavioral neuroscience, providing insights into exploration, anxiety, and the learning processes associated with habituation to novelty. Analyses of exploratory behaviors in open field areas rely heavily on movement changes over time. These activity measures are susceptible to confounds from group differences in locomotor abilities and only provide an indirect measure of learning during exploration.

pmc-13142152.title: TTF-1–positive primary papillary epithelial tumor of the sella with long-term recurrence after multiple resections
pmc-13142152.creator: Vivek Jha, Amal Shaharyar, Vaishali Kaur, Debajyoti Chatterjee, Paramjeet Singh, Pinaki Dutta
pmc-13142152.description: Primary papillary epithelial tumor of the sella is an extremely rare thyroid transcription factor-1 (TTF-1) positive tumor arising from the posterior pituitary and infundibular area and is often mistaken for a nonfunctioning pituitary adenoma. We report a young woman with a recurrent sellar–suprasellar mass over nearly a decade despite multiple transsphenoidal surgeries. The tumor showed progressive enlargement without hormone hypersecretion.

pmc-13669473.title: Oleanolic acid inhibits diet-induced adiposity through blocking neovascularization and macrophage accumulation involving Delta-like 4-Notch 1-nuclear factor-κB signaling
pmc-13669473.creator: Sin-Hye Park, Eunkyeong Kim, Young-Hee Kang
pmc-13669473.description: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVESObesity is a major risk factor in the pathogenesis of cardiometabolic disorders. Most of these obesity-related disorders are closely associated with vascular dysfunctions. Due to the increase of fat mass in obesity, oxygen deficiency is induced, thus developing adipose tissue vascularization. Additionally, local hypoxia generates adipokine expression and proinflammatory macrophage recruitment.
